infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Used only while you're recording a note, so you can capture a task by speaking instead of typing.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Used to turn the note you just spoke into a task. Nothing is recorded in the background.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Used only when you choose a photo of a business card to read. The One Thing never reads your other photos.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Used only when you take a photo of a business card, so it can be read on your phone to add the contact.

plugins.contactsPermission: Used only when you choose a contact to add to People. The One Thing never reads your address book on its own.
